import sys

MOD = 1000000007

def mod_inv(a, m=MOD):
    return pow(a, m-2, m)

INV100 = mod_inv(100)

def popcount(x):
    return bin(x).count('1')

def ctz(x):
    # x > 0
    return (x & -x).bit_length() - 1

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    N = int(next(it))
    p = [[0]*N for _ in range(N)]
    for i in range(N):
        for j in range(N):
            x = int(next(it))
            p[i][j] = x * INV100 % MOD

    # precompute masks by size and id
    masks = [[] for _ in range(N+1)]
    id = [-1] * (1 << N)
    for m in range(1 << N):
        cnt = popcount(m)
        id[m] = len(masks[cnt])
        masks[cnt].append(m)

    dp = {1 << id[0]: 1}

    for i in range(N):
        # precompute mul[m] = product over c of (p[i][c] if bit c set else 1-p[i][c])
        mul = [1] * (1 << N)
        for m in range(1 << N):
            prod = 1
            for c in range(N):
                if (m >> c) & 1:
                    prod = prod * p[i][c] % MOD
                else:
                    prod = prod * (1 - p[i][c]) % MOD
            mul[m] = prod

        nxt = {}
        for st, prob in dp.items():
            # added[c] will be a bitmask of indices of subsets of size i+1
            added = [0] * N
            for sm in masks[i]:
                if (st >> id[sm]) & 1:
                    for c in range(N):
                        if (sm >> c) & 1 == 0:
                            new_mask = sm | (1 << c)
                            added[c] |= 1 << id[new_mask]

            # compute ns[m] for all m>0
            ns = [0] * (1 << N)
            for m in range(1, 1 << N):
                low = m & -m
                c = ctz(low)
                ns[m] = ns[m ^ low] | added[c]
                key = ns[m]
                nxt[key] = (nxt.get(key, 0) + prob * mul[m]) % MOD

        dp = nxt

    full = (1 << N) - 1
    full_id = id[full]
    ans = 0
    for st, prob in dp.items():
        if (st >> full_id) & 1:
            ans = (ans + prob) % MOD
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
